metaTitle: About MedSpa Aestheticians - Victory Medical Services & Medical Spa

blocks.html: I started using Botox to treat TMJ and chronic migraines in 2014. I quickly learned that I have a passion for art of aesthetics. Since 2014, I have had extensive training in therapeutic and cosmetic Botox. I am certified for Botox and various Fillers through the American Academy of Facial Esthetics. I also serve as a consultant for fellow aesthetically trained providers. I believe in whole person care. Wouldn’t it be great to look as good on the outside as you feel on the inside? I can help with both.
Doctorates in Nursing from University of South Alabama with board certification in mental health and family practice.
Therapeutic and cosmetic Botox, Fillers, IV Ketamine Infusion, IV Vitamin Infusion.

With over 5 years of nursing experience and 3+ years in aesthetics, I have a strong clinical background and a passion for achieving natural, long-lasting results. In 2021, travel nursing led me to Austin, where I earned my neurotoxin certification through Texas Laser and Aesthetics. Since then, I have been dedicated to advancing my expertise and staying at the forefront of innovative aesthetic techniques. In December 2024, I completed my Master of Science in Nursing with a 4.0 GPA and am preparing for board certification.

I take a comprehensive approach to aesthetics, integrating injectables like Botox/Dysport, dermal fillers, and Sculptra with lasers and advanced facial treatments for optimal outcomes. I aim to provide personalized care and natural, confidence-boosting enhancements that help clients feel and look their best.
